title: WFDP
description: Official public website for the World Federation for Development and Peace (WFDP), presenting the organization, leadership, branches, mission, plans, and participation flow.
shortDescription: Public website for WFDP at wfdp-igo.org.
fullDescription: WFDP is a multi-page organization site that introduces the federation, its leaders, branch network, mission and goals, and plan details. Visitors can explore participation options and submit a participation request. The interface is structured for bilingual, content-heavy pages while keeping navigation clear across home, leadership, branches, and request flows.
features: Responsive layout for desktop and mobile

title: WFDP Client Dashboard
description: Authenticated client dashboard for WFDP covering office operations, files, support tickets, invoices, calendar, and knowledge base.
shortDescription: Internal client dashboard for WFDP operations.
fullDescription: The WFDP Client Dashboard is the authenticated workspace used by the organization. It includes a president office view, file management, support tickets, invoices, a shared calendar, and a knowledge base. The dashboard is designed for day-to-day operational work rather than public marketing pages, with a consistent sidebar layout and role-based screens.

title: Facebook UI Clone
description: A clone of the Facebook user interface built with React. This project replicates the core layout, navigation, and visual style of Facebook's modern UI, including responsive design, interactive components, and a clean, modular codebase. It demonstrates advanced use of React for component composition, state management, and UI effects, as well as Tailwind CSS for rapid, utility-first styling. Ideal for learning modern frontend techniques and UI/UX best practices.
shortDescription: A modern Facebook UI clone built with React and Tailwind CSS.
fullDescription: This project is a detailed clone of the Facebook user interface, focusing on layout, navigation, and interactivity. It showcases advanced React patterns, state management, and responsive design using Tailwind CSS. The project is ideal for learning how to structure large-scale React apps and implement real-world UI/UX best practices.
